role: Prompt a low-pressure return to the basket
subject: Another look at your basket
preview_text: Revisit the CanvasTrail bag and its practical details.
headline: See the CanvasTrail bag in your basket
body:
The CanvasTrail weekend bag has a removable shoulder strap, so you can keep it attached or take it off. It also includes an internal zipped pocket.

Those two concrete details may be useful as you consider whether this is the canvas weekend bag you want. There is nothing else you need to decide from this message.

Your basket gives you a direct route back to the purchase you began. From there, you can look at the bag again and choose whether you would like to continue toward checkout.
